column1: Routing Agent — Guardrails (Controls on Every Route Plan Produced) — v5 (FINAL)

Every plan produced by Models 1-4 (see All_Parameters, Section 4) must stay inside these guardrails. Distance remains advisory-only throughout (OQ-13). GR-R11 (distance QA check) is confirmed as a monitoring signal, not a build-blocking gate, per the OQ-19 self-resolution.

column2: Never route a DC with null/invalid geo-coordinates (Geo_Complete != TRUE per Data Norm Agent Section 5)
column5: DC excluded from all plans; logged in Dropped_DCs with reason Geo_Incomplete

column2: Never include a Legal_Hold DC in any plan — independent double-check, mirrors BO Config's GR-14
column5: DC removed even if it slipped through the BO Scoring Engine's Ranked_Pool

column1: B — Capacity Guardrails (time and task-count only — distance is advisory-only, per OQ-13)

column2: Never exceed Field_Minutes_Available (420 min) — HARD cap, no bypass
Never exceed 5 tasks/day (R1.7) — HARD cap, no bypass
column5: Plan rejected/re-solved if it selects more than 5 stops

column2: If Min_Travel_Minutes (180 min cumulative floor) can't be satisfied given the candidate pool's geographic spread, fail safe rather than force artificial detours
column5: Flag Travel_Floor_Not_Met; show the best available plan with the shortfall clearly noted

column1: C — Distance Estimation Guardrail (monitoring only, finalized OQ-19)

column2: Every finalized plan's Haversine-derived Total_Distance_KM is reconciled against that day's actual attendance_attendance.google_distance once logged — CONFIRMED as a monitoring/QA signal only, never a build gate and never blocks any plan
column5: If the gap exceeds a defined threshold [FILL IN, e.g. 20%], flag Distance_Estimate_Mismatch for periodic ops review — purely diagnostic, does not affect that day's already-executed plan or block future ones

column2: Never generate fewer than 3 feasible algorithm-generated plans (Models 1-3) without flagging why
column5: Flag Insufficient_Candidates_For_3_Plans; show however many are genuinely distinct; explain why

column2: Never alter Priority_Score or Matched_Purposes computed upstream by the BO Scoring Engine
column5: Treated as a bug, mirrors the Data Norm/BO Config determinism philosophy

column2: Only the SE may finalize plan selection, and only AFTER that SE's punch-in for the day
column5: Non-SE selection attempts are rejected; pre-punch-in selection attempts are held/rejected until punch-in is recorded

column2: For a fixed candidate pool and date snapshot, Models 1-3 must always produce the same 3 plans — no randomization without a fixed seed
column5: Non-reproducible output treated as a bug, same standard as BO Config's GR-16

column2: Every plan-generation run must be logged: which model produced which plan, what inputs were used, what output resulted, and which plan the user selected
column5: Missing log entry blocks that day's plan from being finalized — mirrors BO Config's GR-17
